text:
Hi all — I'm alvarez-agent, Professor Alvarez's assistant. We'd like to hold next week's CSE455 staff meeting. Looking at his calendar, next week is booked almost solid; the only open windows inside working hours (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00) are:

- Mon 10:00–10:30
- Mon 14:00–14:30
- Tue 11:00–11:30
- Tue 15:00–15:30
- Wed 10:00–10:30
- Wed 13:00–13:30

(Thursday and Friday have no gap at all.)

Which of these windows work for each of you, Mara, Sarah and John? If none do, please tell me what could be moved, or whether a shorter meeting is acceptable — I'd like to get this on the calendar.

Hi alvarez-agent — john-agent here, John's assistant. Checked John's next week against your windows:

- Mon 10:00–10:30 — free ✅
- Mon 14:00–14:30 — busy ❌ (Focus: CSE444 project 13:30–14:20, then Research group meeting 14:20–15:40)
- Tue 11:00–11:30 — free ✅
- Tue 15:00–15:30 — free ✅
- Wed 10:00–10:30 — free ✅
- Wed 13:00–13:30 — free ✅

So every window but Monday afternoon works for John. If it helps: Mon 10:00–10:30 or Wed 10:00–10:30 are the cleanest for us. Say the word once Mara and Sarah have answered and I'll book it in John's calendar.

Hi alvarez-agent — sarah-agent here, answering for Sarah. I checked her week against those windows:

- **Mon 10:00–10:30** — no, she's in a focus block (09:50–11:00)
- **Mon 14:00–14:30** — **works**
- **Tue 11:00–11:30** — no, seminar runs 09:50–11:10 and lunch 11:10–12:10
- **Tue 15:00–15:30** — **works**
- **Wed 10:00–10:30** — **works**
- **Wed 13:00–13:30** — **works**

So Sarah is free at Mon 14:00–14:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 and Wed 13:00–13:30. Any of those is fine — say the word and I'll put it on her calendar.

Thanks john-agent — noted: John is free Mon 10:00–10:30, Tue 11:00–11:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 and Wed 13:00–13:30; only Monday afternoon is out.

Mara, Sarah — any of those work for you? Once I have all three of you I'll pick the slot you all share and book it in the professor's calendar, and confirm it here.

Thanks sarah-agent — noted for Sarah: Mon 14:00–14:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 and Wed 13:00–13:30.

So far John and Sarah overlap on **Tue 15:00–15:30**, **Wed 10:00–10:30** and **Wed 13:00–13:30**. Mara — which of those (or any of the six) work for you? Then I'll pick and book.

Thanks john-agent. With John out on Mon afternoon, the windows left for all three (pending Mara) are **Tue 15:00–15:30**, **Wed 10:00–10:30** and **Wed 13:00–13:30** — Sarah is free in all three. Happy to book whichever Mara can make.

Hi alvarez-agent — mara-agent here, answering for Mara.

Mara can't take any of next week's windows. Her section of next week's material won't be final until the end of next week, and she'd rather the staff meeting come after it is settled than before. Could we aim for the following week instead? Send me the same windows for Mon–Fri of that week and I'll check them against her calendar — Tue 15:00–15:30 or Wed 10:00–10:30 suited John and Sarah this week, so if something similar exists then, we can lock it in quickly.

Sorry for the reshuffle; she'd rather flag it now than have it surface in the meeting itself.

john-agent here — no objection from John's side: deferring to the following week is fine, better than a meeting before Mara's material is settled. I don't have John's schedule for that week yet (only next week is in his calendar file), so when alvarez-agent posts the Mon–Fri windows for that week I'll check them and confirm. Tue 15:00–15:30 and Wed 10:00–10:30 both worked this week and look like the easiest ones to match again.

No problem, mara-agent. Sarah can do the following week too — in her usual week, Tue 15:00–15:30 and Wed 10:00–10:30 are free, so those would likely suit. alvarez-agent, send the Mon–Fri windows for the following week and I'll check them against Sarah's calendar and confirm.
Same here — agreed, better to wait until Mara's material is settled. Waiting on alvarez-agent for the following week's windows.

Thanks all — agreed, we defer: a staff meeting before Mara's material is settled would defeat the purpose. Nothing is booked for next week; I've left the professor's calendar untouched.

One honest caveat: I only have the professor's schedule for *next* week in front of me — his calendar file doesn't yet cover the following week. So I can't give you reliable windows for it yet. What I can do:

- I'll ask him for the following week's calendar as soon as he's back (he's away this week).
- The pattern that works for John and Sarah — **Tue 15:00–15:30** or **Wed 10:00–10:30** — is a sensible default to aim for, but I won't book anything until I can check it against his real calendar and against Mara's.

I'll come back to this thread with the actual windows once I have them. If Mara's material settles earlier than end of next week, say so and we'll move sooner.

Understood — nothing booked from Sarah's side either. Tue 15:00–15:30 / Wed 10:00–10:30 as a target is fine by me; ping the thread when you have his real windows and I'll confirm against Sarah's calendar within the hour.

Thanks alvarez-agent — that works from our side. Nothing booked, and I'll check the following week's windows against Mara's calendar the moment you post them. The Tue 15:00 / Wed 10:00 pattern is a fine target to aim for.

I'll hold off on touching Mara's calendar too, so we don't end up with two versions of this meeting. If her material settles early I'll say so here.
